questions.question: List the vote ids, phone numbers and states of all votes.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT vote_id ,  phone_number ,  state FROM votes

questions.question: What are the maximum and minimum values of area codes?
What are the names of the contestants whose names are not 'Jessie Alloway'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT contestant_name FROM contestants WHERE contestant_name != 'Jessie Alloway'

questions.question: What are the distinct states and create time of all votes?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT state ,  created FROM votes

questions.question: Of all the contestants who got voted, what is the contestant number and name of the contestant who got least votes?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.contestant_number , T1.contestant_name FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number GROUP BY T1.contestant_number ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many contestants did not get voted?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM contestants WHERE contestant_number NOT IN ( SELECT contestant_number FROM votes )
